The company shows solid operating profitability (EBIT margin ~20%), supporting earnings-based debt service. However, liquidity is weak with a current ratio of ~0.72 (current assets of 674M vs. current liabilities of 932M), and leverage is meaningful (total liabilities ~66% of total assets), limiting near-term flexibility. Overall, this points to a lower investment-grade credit profile.

DECISION: BBB-
